nodes.description: Immutable address of the logic contract implementation.
Constructor that sets logic and delegatecalls initialization calldata into logic.
Payable fallback that delegatecalls all calls to logic using assembly.
Constructor parameter providing the logic contract address.
Local variable holding the logic address in the fallback.
Assembly delegatecall in fallback forwarding calldata to logic.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns _logic to immutable state variable logic.
Constructor uses _logic as target address for delegatecall.
Constructor passes _initializationCalldata to delegatecall as calldata.
Fallback reads logic state variable into local _impl.
Fallback uses _impl as target address for assembly delegatecall.
Fallback executes assembly delegatecall to logic.
Delegatecall can call back into the fallback function, enabling reentrancy.

normalization_plan.reason: _logic is a constructor parameter directly related to the constructor function.
_initializationCalldata is a constructor parameter passed as calldata to the delegatecall unsafe operation.
_impl is a local variable used as the target address for the delegatecall unsafe operation in fallback.
